title: EscapeMONO
description:
StoryLocked rooms. Strange creatures. A dark laboratory.

You know this isn't a place you should stay for long.

Escaping may seem simple at first... but before you leave, there are mysterious little creatures trapped throughout the laboratory.

Can you save them all — and uncover the truth hidden behind this place?

GameplayEscapeMONO is a cute & creepy point-and-click escape room game with a black-and-white pixel art style.

Explore a mysterious laboratory, investigate rooms, collect items, solve puzzles, and discover clues hidden throughout the environment.

Interact with strange creatures, unlock doors, uncover secrets, and question what really happened inside the laboratory.
description_short: Explore a dark laboratory, interact with strange creatures, find clues, and solve puzzles. Then... just escape?
